name: enron-figshare
license: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), as declared on figshare article 1221767, DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.1221767.v2
source: Felienne Hermans, 'Enron Spreadsheets and Emails', figshare, spreadsheets.7z (992,635,888 bytes; 15,871 .xlsx and 58 .xls members); companion to Hermans and Murphy-Hill, 'Enron's Spreadsheets and Related Emails: A Dataset and Analysis', MSR 2015
sampling: scripts/sample_corpus.py: hash every extracted .xlsx, collapse byte-identical files to the first path, sort unique SHA-256 digests, take the first 1000
notes: Workbooks are fetched locally and never vendored. Member names carry the mailbox owner's name from the public FERC Enron release; extracted files stay on the local machine.
